_comment: Real-world transfer module. The EV-bus solver is the SAME Tier-1 DP / Tier-2 MPC code as the F1 path, driven by this config file. Target deployment: PM e-Bus Sewa electric bus fleets (India).

route._comment: Route model: 'stops' map 1:1 onto F1 braking zones (harvest), 'segments' between stops map onto F1 straights (deploy).

solver._comment: DP discretisation for the bus route (same code path as the F1 Tier-1 DP).

modes._comment: Bus drive modes mapped from F1 postures.

ATTACK.name: Schedule recovery
ATTACK.description: Spend energy to recover schedule; accept higher consumption.

HARVEST.name: Eco / conserve
HARVEST.description: Maximise regen, reduce traction power, protect reserve.

DEFEND.name: Reserve protect
DEFEND.description: Hold state of charge to guarantee depot arrival above reserve.
